title: New Aircrafts & Stunning Liveries in MSFS2024 Marketplace! ✈️✨ | Weekly Update | Week 39
description:
🔍 Description
🚀This week brings an exciting mix of legacy aircraft, modern helicopters, and intriguing livery packs. The NAMC YS-11, also known as the Local Legend 22, has been added, along with two helicopters from Miltech now available for MSFS 2024: the MH-60 and the CH-47D. Additionally, the Griffin and Yak-9 have been introduced as new aircraft.🌍🛫

📹 Other marketplace additions
